title: Java 27 compile and test baseline
requirement: ADR-0012 decision 3 and RT-Q3; enterprise plan §20 workstream RT; register Section J
acceptance: Quorus production classes are compiled for Java 27 (class-file major version 71) and the test suite runs on a Java 27 or later runtime. Written before implementation.

test.entryPoint: Compiled production class file (TransferProtocol.class) and the test JVM runtime version

red.revision: 79e2025 plus the new test only (root pom still at java.version 25)
red.expectedFailure: productionClassesTargetTheJavaBaseline fails because classes are major version 69 (Java 25), not 71 (Java 27)
red.result: Tests run: 2, Failures: 1, Errors: 0. Failure: expected <71> but was <69>. testsRunOnTheJavaBaselineOrLater passed on the JDK 27 runtime. No environment or fixture error.

green.result: Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0. BUILD SUCCESS

regression.lanes: Default groups (docker and slow excluded by the controller configuration)
regression.result: BUILD SUCCESS; all seven reactor entries; 2,387 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped (core 1,519; workflow 134; tenant 64; controller 569; agent 101; integration examples 0); all five JaCoCo gates met; JaCoCo analysed the Java 27 class files with no instrumentation errors

limitations: Docker and slow groups were not run. The controller and agent Dockerfiles, the Compose build arguments and the CI container still use Eclipse Temurin 25 images, which cannot compile --release 27 or run Java 27 classes. Temurin publishes no Java 27 images (checked 2026-09-26). This is slice RT-01b, blocked on decision RT-Q4.
Until RT-01b lands, image builds, the Compose quick start and Docker-tagged tests are broken by this change. It should not be committed on its own unless that window is explicitly accepted.
Only quorus-core carries the class-file assertion. The other modules inherit the same root property, and the reactor proves they compile and pass tests on JDK 27.
sensitiveDataCheck: Logs contain Maven and test output only; no request bodies, credentials, keys or sensitive payloads were captured.
